text: 财政部印发《会计改革与发展“十五五”规划》。其中提出，会计监督作用更好发挥。会计监督体系更加健全，打击财务造假工作机制进一步完善，对重点领域的监督、突出问题的整治持续发力，精准性、有效性不断提升，推动财务造假存量加快出清、增量得到有效遏制。
text_en: The Ministry of Finance issued the "Accounting Reform and Development 15th Five-Year Plan." It proposes that the role of accounting supervision be better leveraged. The accounting supervision system will be more robust, the mechanism for combating financial fraud will be further improved, supervision over key areas and rectification of prominent problems will continue to intensify, precision and effectiveness will keep improving, and efforts will be made to accelerate the clearing of the stock of financial fraud and effectively curb new occurrences.
